constrained_violations.claim: The ark of the covenant with the mercy seat stayed WITHIN the most holy place, behind the veil - never out in the open court before the people.
constrained_violations.actual: The golden ark with cherubim and carrying poles is shown OUT in the open courtyard before the crowd, with fire/incense burning on it.

notes: Tent (not stone) is correct; gold vestments are in the open court (acceptable as licence here), no gold within the veil. The real contradiction: the ark is depicted in the open court before the people instead of behind the veil. With the ark fact now present, this scene correctly FAILS.
